mapper.select: SELECT dict_code, dict_sort, dict_label, dict_value, dict_type, css_class, list_class, is_default, STATUS, create_by, create_time, remark FROM sys_dict_data WHERE STATUS = '0' AND dict_type = #{dictType} ORDER BY dict_sort ASC

select t.* from ( select DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS "alarmTypeId", sat.type_name AS "typeName", sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS "typeValue" FROM vm_order_algorithms t1 inner JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t t2 ON t1.algorithm_code = t2.algorithm_code inner JOIN vm_algorithm_alarm al ON t2.algo_min_type_code = al.algo_min_type inner JOIN sys_alarm_type sat ON al.alarm_type = sat.type_value WHERE sat.alarm_source = '1' and t2.app_scenarios = '1' and t1.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY sat.alarm_type_id ASC ) t union SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS "alarmTypeId", sat.type_name AS "typeName", sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS "typeValue" FROM sys_alarm_type sat WHERE sat.tenant_id is null and sat.industry_code is null union select distinct sat.alarm_type_id AS "alarmTypeId", sat.type_name AS "alarmTypeName", sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS "typeValue" from vm_order_sensor_devices t1 INNER JOIN vm_sensor_monitor_status ms on t1.device_code=ms.device_code INNER JOIN vm_sensor_monitor_config mc on ms.monitor_code=mc.monitor_code INNER JOIN sys_alarm_type sat on mc.alarm_type=sat.type_value where sat.alarm_source = '8' and t1.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) union SELECT DISTINCT t.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, t.type_name AS typeName, t.icon AS icon, t.type_value AS typeValue FROM sys_alarm_type t INNER JOIN sys_scene_alarm_rel r ON t.type_value = r.alarm_type OR t.type_value = r.scene_id WHERE r.delete_flag= '0' AND t.delete_flag='0'

SELECT (select b.grid_name from bm_grid b where b.delete_flag = 0 and b.grid_code=a.parent_code and b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and b.industry_code = a.industry_code) as "parentName", a.grid_id AS "gridId", a.is_end AS "isEnd", a.grid_code AS "gridCode", a.grid_name AS "gridName", a.parent_id AS "parentId", a.parent_code AS "parentCode", a.grid_level AS "gridLevel", a.create_time AS "createTime", a.point_status AS "pointStatus", a.color, a.grid_center AS "gridCenter", a.border_color AS "borderColor", a.border_color_transparency AS "borderColorTransparency", a.border_color_line_thickness AS "borderColorLineThickness", a.color_transparency AS "colorTransparency" FROM bm_grid a WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 order by a.grid_sort

SELECT a.device_code, a.device_name, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.location, a.province_id, a.city_id, a.county_id, a.height, a.model_code AS "modelId", p.area_name AS "provinceName", ci.area_name AS "cityName", co.area_name AS "countyName", a.alarm_location, t.focus_range AS "focusRange", t.verti_down_neg AS "vertiDownNeg", t.device_model_code AS "deviceModelCode", a.category_code AS deviceType, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'device_type' AND DICT_VALUE = a.category_code LIMIT 1 ) as deviceTypeName, a.device_sub_type AS deviceSubType, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'device_subtype' AND DICT_VALUE = a.device_sub_type LIMIT 1 ) as deviceSubTypeName, ct.channel_name AS "channelName" FROM vm_device_info_t a LEFT JOIN vm_device_model_t t ON a.device_model_code = t.device_model_code AND a.model_code = t.mfgr_code LEFT JOIN sys_area p ON a.province_id = p.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area ci ON a.city_id = ci.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area co ON a.county_id = co.area_code LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t ct ON ct.device_code = a.device_code WHERE a.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT a.latitude, a.longitude, a.location, a.province_id, a.city_id, a.county_id, a.height, a.model_code AS "modelId", a.device_code, a.device_name, a.device_model_code AS "deviceModelCode", p.area_name AS "provinceName", ci.area_name AS "cityName", co.area_name AS "countyName" FROM vm_iot_device_t a LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_model_t t ON a.device_model_code = t.device_model_code AND a.model_code = t.mfgr_code LEFT JOIN sys_area p ON a.province_id = p.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area ci ON a.city_id = ci.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area co ON a.county_id = co.area_code WHERE a.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT t.tenant_id, t.industry_code, t.device_code AS "vidiconCode", r.device_code, d.device_name, d.longitude, d.latitude, d.model_code, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'iot_device_mfgr_code' AND DICT_VALUE = d.model_code LIMIT 1 ) "modelCodeName", d.location, d.height, d.category_code AS deviceType, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'device_type' AND DICT_VALUE = d.category_code LIMIT 1 ) as deviceTypeName, d.device_sub_type AS deviceSubType, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'device_subtype' AND DICT_VALUE = d.device_sub_type LIMIT 1 ) as deviceSubTypeName FROM vm_tenant_iot_device_conf_t t LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_iot_conf_rel_t r ON t.iot_device_conf_id = r.iot_device_conf_id LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t d ON d.device_code = r.device_code AND d.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT t.device_code AS deviceCode, t.device_name AS deviceName, t.manufacturer_code AS manufacturerCode, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'uav_manufacturer' AND DICT_VALUE = t.manufacturer_code LIMIT 1 ) modelFactoryName, t.model_code, model.model_name AS deviceModelCode, t.location AS location, t.longitude, t.latitude FROM vm_uav_device_info_t t LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_model_t model ON t.model_code = model.model_code and model.delete_flag = 0 WHERE t.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT n.device_code AS deviceCode, n.device_code AS uavNestCode, n.device_name AS uavNestName, nestM.model_name AS deviceModel, ( SELECT DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data WHERE DICT_TYPE = 'uav_nest_manufacturer' AND DICT_VALUE = n.manufacturer_code LIMIT 1 ) modelCodeName, n.manufacturer_code AS modelCode FROM vm_uav_nest_device_info n LEFT JOIN vm_uav_nest_device_model_t nestM ON n.model_code = nestM.model_code and nestM.delete_flag = 0 WHERE n.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT osd.tenant_id, osd.industry_code, a.device_code, IFNULL( b.device_name, a.device_name ) AS "deviceName", a.latitude, a.longitude, a.location, a.province_id, a.city_id, a.county_id, a.height, a.model_code AS "modelId", a.device_model_code AS "deviceModelCode", p.area_name AS "provinceName", ci.area_name AS "cityName", co.area_name AS "countyName" FROM vm_order_sensor_devices osd LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t a ON a.device_code = osd.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_iot_device_rel_t b ON b.device_code = osd.device_code AND osd.tenant_id = b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_area p ON a.province_id = p.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area ci ON a.city_id = ci.area_code LEFT JOIN sys_area co ON a.county_id = co.area_code WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' AND osd.category_code = 1 AND osd.ord_status IN (0,1,2)
SELECT t.coll_obj_code AS "collObjCode" FROM vm_user_device_collection_t t WHERE t.coll_obj_type = '5'

SELECT industry_code AS "industryCode", industry_name AS "industryName" FROM sys_industry_conf WHERE `status` = 1 AND delete_flag = 0
and accept_node =#{localNode}
SELECT preset_id AS "presetId", preset_name AS "presetName" FROM vm_video_preset

SELECT a.task_id AS "taskId", c.industry_code AS "industryCode", c.monitor_area_id AS "monitorAreaId", l.custom_name AS "layerName", l.id AS "layerId", c.feature_id AS "featureId", c.tbbh FROM vm_algorithm_config a LEFT JOIN vm_polygon_patch_algo_area_rela p ON a.config_id = p.config_id LEFT JOIN vm_polygon_patch_config c ON c.polygon_id = p.polygon_id AND c.monitor_area_id = p.monitor_area_id LEFT JOIN sys_layer l ON l.id = c.layer_id WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND p.delete_flag = 0 AND c.delete_flag = 0

SELECT t1.`polygon_id` AS "polygonId", t1.`monitor_area_id` AS "monitorAreaId", t1.`polygon_points` AS "polygonPoints", t1.`device_code` AS "deviceCode", t1.`channel_code` AS "channelCode", t1.`layer_id` AS "layerId", t1.`feature_id` AS "featureId", CONCAT( '电子围栏', t1.polygon_no ) AS "polygonName", t1.`tbbh` AS tbbh FROM vm_polygon_patch_config t1 LEFT JOIN sys_layer t2 ON t1.layer_id = t2.id WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0

#{item}

SELECT algorithm_code AS "algorithmCode", algorithm_name AS "algorithmName" FROM vm_algorithm_info_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' and app_scenarios = '1'
select r.device_code, l.label_id, l.label_name from vm_tower_device_labels_rel r inner join vm_tower_label_config l on r.label_id = l.label_id where l.delete_flag = 0
